children: Basis bids for soybeans and corn shipped by barge to the US Gulf Coast were lower on Tuesday as traders turned their attention to coming US stocks data and a rain-soaked harvest in parts of the Midwest.
The results of last week's US-China summit underwhelmed the market and drove down prices.

The decline encouraged bargain buyers to emerge before the US Department of Agriculture issues a quarterly stocks report on Wednesday, traders said. They also adjusted positions before the end of the month and quarter.
